ios.desc:
Push The Button (PTB) and Hold The Button (HTB) have captivated over 250,000 players from around the world!
Discover why thousands of players are downloading this addicting game every day.

If you think you’re fast, try your speed with Push The Button! See how many times you can push the button in 30 seconds!!! Compete against yourself and with players from around the world.

Once you think you’ve mastered Push The Button (PTB) try your stamina with Hold The Button (HTB).

More graphics! More animations! More fun!
